Das sind wir.
Fitness-Tracker zeigen uns buchstäblich auf Schritt und Tritt, wie es um unsere Bewegungsbilanz steht. Mit Cheftresor haben wir eine Plattform geschaffen, die genau das für die Kennzahlen von Unternehmen leistet. Sie ermöglicht Steuerberatern, vorausschauend zu agieren, und Unternehmen, ihre Daten effektiv und gewinnbringend zu nutzen.
Bei Cheftresor dreht sich alles um Innovation und Fortschritt. Unsere Mission: Unternehmen und Steuerberater mit smarten Softwarelösungen zu stärken und ihre Zusammenarbeit grundlegend zu transformieren. Als junges Unternehmen, das gleichzeitig auf über 30 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Buchhaltung und Controlling zurückgreift, entwickeln wir Tools, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.
Doch Innovation allein ist nicht alles – wir setzen genauso auf ein wertschätzendes und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jeder individuell entfalten kann. Bei uns steht Teamwork an erster Stelle: keine Ellenbogenmentalität, sondern ein agiles Miteinander, das Veränderung bewirkt und Türen öffnet.
Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!
Aufgaben
Das erwartet dich.
Als Senior Frontend Entwickler (m/w/d) sorgst du dafür, dass aus komplexen Daten ein Produkt wird, das gerne genutzt wird. Du entwickelst nicht einfach Oberflächen, sondern prägst die Nutzererfahrung unserer Plattform aktiv mit. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Entwicklung, Produkt und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst deine Erfahrung in technische Entscheidungen genauso ein wie in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts. Konkret erwarten dich folgende Aufgaben:
Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, performante und intuitiv nutzbare Frontends für unsere Controlling-Plattformen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer UI-Struktur, Komponenten und Frontend-Architektur.
Du arbeitest eng mit Backend, Product Owner und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um Anforderungen in starke Nutzererlebnisse zu übersetzen.
Du bringst deine Erfahrung in Code-Qualität, Testing, Reviews und technische Standards aktiv ins Team ein.
Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und gehst offen neue Wege, wenn sie das Produkt besser machen.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit.
Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur coden, sondern auch mitdenken möchte. Du solltest sehr eigenverantwortlich arbeiten können und Spaß daran haben, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die unsere Kunden wirklich weiterbringen. Darüber hinaus findest du dich in folgenden Punkten wieder:
Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Frontend-Development, idealerweise auf Senior-Niveau.
Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien mit
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem klaren Qualitätsanspruch.
Du hast Interesse an KI-gestützten Anwendungen und idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit der Integration von KI oder Machine-Learning-Funktionen in Softwareprodukte.
Du denkst pragmatisch, lösungsorientiert und hast Lust, in einem wachsenden Umfeld aktiv mitzugestalten.

Das bieten wir dir.
Unser Team ist unser größtes Kapital, und das soll auch so bleiben. Deshalb sorgen wir dafür, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst. Bei uns erwarten dich:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine zielführende Work-Life-Balance.
Attraktives Gehalt zwischen 75.000 € und 95.000 € – je nach Berufserfahrung und Tätigkeitsbereich.
Vielfältige Karriereperspektiven mit spannenden Entwicklungs- und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Sachbezüge, Zuschüsse und betriebliche Kranken- und Rentenversicherung.
Teamevents und regelmäßige Traditionen wie unser Freitagsfrühstück oder gemeinsames Kochen.
Moderne, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze in top-ausgestatteten Räumlichkeiten.
Home-Office nach individueller Absprache.
Klingt gut? Dann warte nicht länger!
Wenn du Lust hast, in einem digitalen Umfeld Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Teil eines Teams zu werden, das die Zukunft der Steuerberatung aktiv mitgestaltet, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!
Bewirb dich jetzt über das Bewerberformular mit nur wenigen Klicks – schnell, einfach und stressfrei.

Du liebst sauberen Code, denkst in Komponenten und willst Interfaces bauen, die echten Impact haben? Dann komm zu MediPulse!
Healthcare is broken. Das wollen wir ändern, und dafür suchen wir Dich!
Als Frontend Engineer baust du die Oberfläche, mit der Ärzt:innen und Praxismanager:innen ihren Praxisalltag steuern. Von der ersten Komponente bis zum fertigen Feature entwickelst du mit Next.js das Produkt, das medizinische Praxen endlich ins 21. Jahrhundert bringt – und prägst dabei maßgeblich, wie es aussieht und sich anfühlt. Wir shippen mehrmals pro Woche und arbeiten eng mit echten Praxen zusammen – du siehst den Impact deiner Arbeit sofort, nicht erst in drei Monaten.
MediPulse ist ein dynamisches HealthTech Startup, das Arztpraxen endlich ins 21. Jahrhundert bringt. Wir revolutionieren den Gesundheitssektor mit unserer innovativen Software, die Ärzten hilft, ihre Praxen effizienter zu steuern.
In unserem kleinen, aber hochmotivierten Team kannst du viel Verantwortung übernehmen und arbeitest direkt mit unseren erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an Themen, die echten Impact haben. Unser Entwicklerteam bringt durchweg 5+ Jahre Erfahrung mit – du arbeitest von Tag eins mit Leuten auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, richtig was zu bewegen, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Aufgaben

Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts mit Next.js
Umsetzung neuer Features von der Idee bis zum Live-Deployment – wir shippen mehrmals pro Woche
Du gestaltest Produkt und UI/UX maßgeblich mit – von der Konzeption bis zur fertigen Oberfläche
Enger Austausch mit Ärzt:innen und Praxen, deren Feedback direkt in dein nächstes Feature fließt
Sicherstellung von Performance, Code-Qualität und Wartbarkeit
Mitgestaltung unserer Frontend-Architektur und technischer Entscheidungen
Qualifikation

Du hast Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit Next.js (React) – ob frisch durchgestartet oder mit einigen Jahren auf dem Buckel
Du fühlst dich in TypeScript zuhause und schreibst sauberen, wartbaren Code
Du hast ein Auge für gutes UI/UX und Spaß daran, durchdachte Interfaces zu bauen
Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst mit und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
Erfahrung mit modernem Tooling (Git, CI/CD) ist ein Plus
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse

Office direkt am Marienplatz
Ein junges, dynamisches Team, das eng vor Ort zusammenarbeitet
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Raum für Home-Office
Moderne Hardware deiner Wahl (z. B. MacBook)
Direkter Draht zu echten Nutzer:innen und sichtbarer Impact ab Tag eins

Viel Verantwortung und die Chance, unser Produkt von Grund auf mitzugestalten
Bereit, Healthcare besser zu machen?
Kein langes Anschreiben nötig – uns interessiert, was du kannst und was dich antreibt. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gerne dein GitHub oder Portfolio. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir gemeinsam bauen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Nordason steht für durchdachtes Design, klare Linien und Qualität.
Unser Webshop ist der zentrale Teil unseres Geschäftsmodells. Deshalb entwickeln wir ihn nicht über isolierte Features weiter, sondern betrachten das Frontend ganzheitlich - von Performance und Nutzerführung über Produktdarstellung und Navigation bis hin zu Warenkorb und Checkout. UX, Technologie und E-Commerce greifen dabei eng ineinander.
Als Frontend Developer verantwortest du den wichtigsten digitalen Berührungspunkt zwischen unseren Kunden und Nordason. Du gestaltest das Frontend unseres Webshops ganzheitlich und prägst damit maßgeblich, wie Nutzer unsere Marke erleben, Produkte entdecken und durch den Kaufprozess geführt werden. Dabei begleitest du Themen von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live, bringst eigene technische Lösungsansätze ein und entwickelst den Webshop über einzelne Features hinaus kontinuierlich weiter.
Aufgaben
Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Frontend-Komponenten für unseren Webshop
Technische Umsetzung von UX/UI-Konzepten in performante und responsive Weboberflächen
Ganzheitliche Weiterentwicklung von Produktseiten, Landingpages, Navigation, Warenkorb und Checkout
Entwicklung wiederverwendbarer und wartbarer Frontend-Komponenten
Optimierung von Ladezeiten, Web-Performance und technischer Qualität
Testing, Debugging und Fehleranalyse im laufenden Shop-Betrieb
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, UX und externen Technologiepartnern
Technische Bewertung und Abnahme extern entwickelter Frontend-Lösungen
Einbringung eigener Ideen und technischer Lösungsansätze zur Verbesserung von Customer Experience und Conversion
Qualifikation
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS/SCSS und JavaScript (Must-have)
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Git und Versionskontrolle zur strukturierten Zusammenarbeit an Codebasen
Praktische Erfahrung mit React.js, Vue.js oder einem vergleichbaren modernen Frontend-Framework
Bereitschaft, dich in Odoos komponentenbasiertes Frontend-Framework Owl einzuarbeiten (vorhandene Owl-Erfahrung von Vorteil)
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung responsiver Webanwendungen oder E-Commerce-Frontends
Gutes Verständnis für komponentenbasierte Frontend-Entwicklung und moderne Webarchitekturen
Erfahrung mit TypeScript und E-Commerce-Plattformen von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in Web-Performance, Core Web Vitals oder technischem SEO von Vorteil
Eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Bereitschaft, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und sich in neue Systeme und Technologien einzuarbeiten

Ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Frontend-Weiterentwicklung unseres Webshops
Direkter Einfluss auf Customer Journey, Shop-Performance und Conversion
Möglichkeit, technische Standards, Komponenten und Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, UX und externen Technologiepartnern
Kurze Wege zwischen technischer Idee, Entscheidung und Umsetzung
Abwechslungsreiches Tätigkeitsfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
Ein motiviertes, dynamisches und kollegiales Team
Sicherer und zukunftsorientierter Arbeitsplatz, an dem Du Deine Motivation und Persönlichkeit einbringen kannst
Ein schönes und modernes Büro in Hamburg-Othmarschen mit inspirierender Arbeitsatmosphäre und sonniger Dachterrasse
Eine Unternehmenskultur, die auf Offenheit, Vertrauen und Entwicklung basiert
Hybrider Arbeitsmodus mit 3 Bürotagen pro Woche
30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr

Job Description
CelebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use.
You will join the engineering team behind our new mid-market analytics platform, building the interface customers rely on to explore data, understand performance, and turn complex information into actionable insights. You will work closely with product, design, and backend engineering to create a fast, accessible, and consistent experience as the platform grows.

Build and maintain the customer-facing application using React and TypeScript
Create intuitive dashboards, data exploration experiences, and interactive visualization components
Help evolve CelebriOS's shared component library in close collaboration with product design
Own frontend performance for views that work with large and complex datasets
Build accessible interfaces that meet WCAG AA standards and continuously improve the user experience
Work with backend engineers to shape APIs and data structures around real product requirements
Contribute to frontend architecture and technical decisions as the product and engineering team evolve
Review code, share knowledge, and contribute to a strong frontend engineering culture

3+ years of professional experience building production frontends with React and TypeScript
Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, and modern frontend patterns
Hands-on experience building accessible web applications
Experience working with data-heavy or complex user interfaces
Ability to explain the technical and product decisions behind work you have built
Comfortable collaborating closely with designers and giving and receiving constructive feedback
Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the overall user experience

Experience with data-visualization libraries such as D3 or Recharts
Experience contributing to or building a design system
Frontend performance profiling and optimization
Figma fluency
Experience building analytics, reporting, or B2B SaaS products

$95,000-$125,000 determined based on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit for the role.
CelebriOS offers a remote-first working environment, professional development opportunities, and a benefits package designed to support our team. Full details of compensation, benefits, and other employment terms will be discussed during the interview process.

Application review → introductory conversation → technical discussion → conversation with the team → offer.
We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with clear communication throughout the process.

CelebriOS is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to make the process accessible.
Location: Remote

Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido las bases de datos, gobierno, procesos y sistemas que hacen posible que la inteligencia funcione en la operación real del negocio. En Keyrus , no nos enfocamos en pilotos aislados.

Ayudamos a las organizaciones a llevar la IA a producción, integrarla en sus procesos y convertirla en resultados sostenibles: operacionalizamos la inteligencia. La IA no reemplaza a las personas. Las reposiciona donde más valor generan: entendiendo, decidiendo, diseñando y creando. En este rol, no solo desarrollarás habilidades técnicas.

También fortalecerás tu criterio, tu capacidad de arquitectura y tu forma de resolver problemas reales con clientes. Con el tiempo, podrás crecer como uno de esos perfiles que conectan datos, IA y toma de decisiones humanas a escala, trabajando con diferentes industrias, equipos y geografías. Este no es solo un rol que ocupar.

Es una disciplina que desarrollar y una historia que ayudarás a construir, como parte de los equipos que hacen de Keyrus un Arquitecto de Inteligencia. La tecnología amplifica. La cultura de Keyrus marca la diferencia. El rigor operativo conecta ambas para convertir la inteligencia en impacto real.

Qué harás en este rol: Como Frontend Developer (Magento) , serás responsable de asegurar la evolución, estabilidad y mantenibilidad de la capa de presentación de plataformas e-commerce, desarrollando interfaces modernas, responsivas y de alto desempeño que impactan directamente la experiencia del usuario y la continuidad operativa del negocio.

Desarrollar y mantener interfaces web para plataformas Magento, asegurando componentes reutilizables, escalables y alineados con los requerimientos del proyecto. Implementar nuevas funcionalidades frontend, garantizando una experiencia de usuario consistente, accesible y responsive.

Participar en el desarrollo de temas, componentes y personalizaciones dentro del ecosistema Magento. Ejecutar mantenimiento evolutivo y correctivo sobre la capa frontend, atendiendo incidentes, ajustes funcionales y mejoras continuas.

Corregir errores y optimizar componentes existentes para mejorar el rendimiento, la usabilidad y la experiencia del usuario final. Colaborar con desarrolladores backend, QA, analistas funcionales y otros miembros del equipo para implementar soluciones integrales.

Gestionar y versionar cambios mediante Git, siguiendo buenas prácticas de integración y control de versiones. Consumir APIs y servicios para integrar funcionalidades dinámicas dentro de la interfaz de usuario. Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo frontend, incluyendo clean code, reutilización de componentes, documentación técnica y mantenibilidad.

Participar en pruebas y validación de desarrollos para asegurar entregas funcionales y listas para despliegue. Acompañar procesos de transferencia de conocimiento hacia equipos internos, promoviendo continuidad operativa y adopción técnica.

Qué esperamos de ti: Que combines criterio técnico con una ejecución consistente en contextos de evolución y mantenimiento de plataformas digitales. Que tengas una mentalidad orientada a resolver problemas reales con enfoque práctico y atención a la experiencia del usuario.

Que valores la calidad del código y entiendas su impacto en el desempeño, mantenibilidad y escalabilidad del frontend. Que puedas trabajar de forma autónoma sin perder alineación con estándares, tiempos y objetivos del equipo. Que seas una persona cuidadosa con el detalle visual y funcional al trabajar sobre plataformas activas.

Que comuniques de forma clara avances, riesgos técnicos y decisiones de implementación. Que tengas disposición para colaborar en entornos dinámicos, con foco en continuidad, aprendizaje y mejora constante.

Qué aportas: Formación y certificaciones: Formación en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Desarrollo de Software, Ciencias de la Computación o carreras afines. Valoramos certificaciones o cursos en desarrollo frontend, JavaScript, Magento, desarrollo web o tecnologías asociadas al ecosistema e-commerce.

Habilidades técnicas: Más de 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo Frontend . Experiencia previa en proyectos de comercio electrónico. Experiencia comprobable desarrollando aplicaciones web modernas. Dominio de HTML5, CSS3 y JavaScript (ES6+) . Experiencia con Magento, especialmente en desarrollo y personalización de frontend.

Experiencia desarrollando interfaces responsivas y compatibles con múltiples navegadores. Experiencia consumiendo APIs REST para integración con servicios backend. Conocimientos sólidos en control de versiones con Git. Experiencia en mantenimiento evolutivo y correctivo de aplicaciones web.

Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de desarrollo frontend, incluyendo clean code, optimización de rendimiento y documentación técnica. Experiencia en proyectos de e-commerce. Deseables: Experiencia con la arquitectura frontend de Magento. Experiencia con procesos de optimización de rendimiento web (Core Web Vitals).

Conocimiento de procesos de deployment y soporte a salidas productivas en entornos web. Experiencia trabajando con equipos distribuidos en modalidad remota. Familiaridad con análisis técnico y estimación de esfuerzo para requerimientos evolutivos. Qué te ayudará a tener éxito: Comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y funcionales.

Atención al detalle tanto visual como funcional. Capacidad para priorizar tareas según criticidad e impacto en la experiencia del usuario. Enfoque en documentar decisiones, cambios y consideraciones técnicas relevantes. Disposición para aprender rápidamente el contexto del proyecto y adaptarte a nuevas necesidades.

Hábito de validar la experiencia de usuario antes de liberar cambios. Capacidad para equilibrar velocidad de entrega con calidad de implementación. Comportamiento proactivo para levantar bloqueos a tiempo y proponer alternativas de solución. Orientación a dar seguimiento completo a los desarrollos hasta su validación y cierre.

Proceso de selección Nuestro proceso busca conocer tu experiencia, tu capacidad técnica y tu ajuste al rol de manera ágil y clara: Conversación con Talent Acquisition para revisar tu trayectoria, motivación, expectativas y ajuste general a la posición.

Entrevista técnica de aproximadamente 45 minutos para profundizar en tu experiencia con Ecommerce , Magento , otras herramientas técnicas y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, e-commerce y buenas prácticas de desarrollo. Entrevista final con liderazgo para revisar fit con el equipo, contexto del proyecto y expectativas de desempeño en el rol.

Rewards / Qué ofrecemos Esta posición es remota y estará ubicada en cualquier ciudad de Colombia . El contrato es a término fijo por 6 a 8 semanas, con posibilidad de extensión o renovación . Las condiciones y beneficios aplicables pueden variar según la ubicación y la naturaleza del contrato.

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Web/UI Engineer to develop a data-rich and reliable user experience. These frontends are constructed using JS, CSS, React, and Flutter, and serve as Canonical’s enterprise products that act as the company's face to our users.
In order to create consistency across our products and sites, we have a central team that builds an open-source React toolkit and presentation layer, the Vanilla Framework . We are excited to develop this further and see if we can help more open-source projects build performant and accessible interfaces that respond well to diverse layouts. We use REST APIs for communication, and we consider API design an important part of the process.
Flutter is a new front-end technology that has the potential to unify our desktop and web development. We are growing the team's exposure to Flutter and have roles on both web and Ubuntu engineering for this specialism.
We hire developers with outstanding academic results and a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge web technologies. In these roles, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high-quality, front-end and back-end code while exhibiting technical leadership, exceptional design, and intuitive user experience.
Additionally, we encourage colleagues to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.
Location : This is a Globally remote role.

Owning a home has slipped out of reach for millions of Americans. Cedar has built a model that changes that, we’ve proven it by closing deals, and now we’re scaling. You get the stability of a company that’s proven its model, plus the ownership and scope of an early hire.
How we work: results over hours, straight feedback, and problems fixed at the root. People who learn fast and take ownership earn serious responsibility quickly. The bar is high, but you won’t be clearing it alone, and the people around you are very good at what they do.
AI is central to how we build. We invest heavily in our tooling so a small team can ship like a much bigger one, and we want people who keep pushing on what these tools can do. They are meant to speed you up, not to think for you, and you own the result.

Ownership from week one. You’ll be shipping to customers, not waiting around for permission.
Room to grow. Take on more as soon as you’re ready, not on a fixed timeline.
A small, sharp team and tooling that’s a pleasure to work with, so your time goes to the interesting problems.
Competitive pay and meaningful equity, so you share in what you help build.

Build and own the consumer-facing web app in React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
Lean on our AI tooling to ship quickly, and help make it better as you go.
Be fanatical about testing your assumptions and judging your work by outcomes. AI speeds you up, but it doesn’t think for you, so the verification is on you.
Take dense financial logic and turn it into screens people can understand and trust.
Work shoulder to shoulder with design and product, from rough idea to shipped, accessible UI.
Own features from build to release, then watch how people use them and make them better.
Keep the bar high in code review, write tests that matter, and chase bugs to their root cause.
Your first 90 days
First couple of weeks: get set up, ship a small change to production, and learn how we work.
First month: own a feature end to end, from design handoff through release.
By 90 days: you’re the go-to person for a meaningful slice of the consumer app.

A few years (roughly 3+) building production web apps with React and TypeScript.
You’re solid on HTML and CSS, and you make things work on a phone, not just a laptop.

You’re excited about our AI tooling and want to push it further.

Remote-first and full-time. You can work from anywhere in the US, and a good number of us are around New York City if you’d rather not work solo.
You’ll report to Brien Kurtz, our VP of Engineering.

AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.

The Growth team owns the surfaces that turn someone who just signed up into a paying customer who sticks around — onboarding, activation, billing and checkout. The operating mode is simple: find the fastest path to learning, ship it, then standardize and clean up. The Growth team ships in weeks what other teams might take months to do.

s.h: Two of our exciting projects right now
s.t:
Agent-forward experience. We're exploring how agents and AI can make the experience better for our customers and demonstrate the value of Close faster. Our focus is helping users get real value from the product, not just automating on their behalf.
Creating data from unstructured sources. We're building ways to turn the information customers already have, like their inbox, into a working CRM, so they can skip the manual data entry and see value from Close faster.
One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close.
You are
A seasoned frontend engineer. React is our bread and butter, but perhaps you've worked across Vue, Svelte, or Solid. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You've seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct.
Fluent in experimentation. You understand what data points to capture in an experiment, what a funnel looks like, and how to design a feature so it produces meaningful data — not just ship it and hope. This is the core of the role.
Experienced with B2B experiment structure. A strong bonus: you've worked in Amplitude on the implementation side, not just the technical configuration side.
Building AI-powered interfaces. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have an opinion on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to make them feel reliable. You know how to design for streamed responses, uncertain states, and agent-driven UIs.
Working with AI daily. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work.
A builder first. You'd rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship — and you're comfortable standardizing and cleaning up after the learning lands.
You will
Build agent-forward onboarding. An agent that teaches by doing: clicking around, highlighting, demonstrating the app while it talks to the user. You'll own the UI layer that makes an agent feel like a trainer instead of a chat window — and help find the balance between the agent doing everything and the user learning enough to make Close's workflow their own.
Turn an inbox into a CRM. Build the experience around our unstructured-data pipeline: a user connects their email, and we surface detected deals, contacts, and a full book of business. Your job is making that moment feel like magic — and making it trustworthy enough to act on.
Design experiments, not just features. Decide what to instrument, define the funnel, and structure metrics so a B2B reality (org-level conversion, user-level behavior) still yields clean answers. You'll own this in Amplitude end to end.
Work across the whole app. Growth doesn't stay in its lane — onboarding, activation, billing, import, and whatever surface the next experiment needs. The Growth team experiments touch every aspect of the product.
Move at learning speed. Fastest path to insight first, then standardize and clean up. You'll ship in weeks what elsewhere takes months, and help decide which prototypes deserve to become permanent.
Have ownership and autonomy. The team is relatively new. How Growth frontend engineering works at Close is, in part, yours to shape.
Tech you'll touch: TypeScript, React, Vite, Amplitude, CSS Modules, Storybook, Playwright, WebSockets — plus the agent stack behind Chloe.

s.h: Some examples of what it means to be a Senior at Perk
s.t:
Shape the bigger picture. You won't just build features, you'll refine the what to build and why . At Perk, senior engineers are expected to go beyond the technical solution and focus on the problem itself. You'll contribute to your squad's quarterly goals and long-term vision alongside your Product Manager and Engineering Manager.
Architect for today and tomorrow. When a big change is needed in how our platform works, you'll be the one writing the design documents that lay the foundation.

You'll become a guardian of your team's technical quality; spotting areas of investment, proactively managing technical debt, and making sure we don't let "busy work" crowd out the work that truly matters. At Perk, we believe in impact over effort : our customers see results, not the hours behind them.

Your job is to make sure we're always investing our energy where it counts most.
Lead across boundaries. Your influence won't stop at your own squad. You'll communicate complex ideas across multiple teams, proactively identify who needs to be involved, and drive alignment across the broader organisation. Whether it's coordinating a cross-squad initiative, contributing to one of our engineering guilds (where engineers from different teams align on shared technical topics), or pairing with architects on solution discovery, you'll operate comfortably beyond your immediate team.
Raise the bar for everyone around you. Senior engineers at Perk are mentors, coaches, and bar raisers. You'll support less experienced colleagues through direct mentorship, thoughtful feedback during reviews, and by modelling what great engineering looks like in practice.

You'll help Engineering Managers understand where the team needs to grow technically, and you'll use spaces like guild meetings, design doc reviews, and pairing sessions to lift the overall standard. At Perk, we are a team , the team's success is your success.
How We Work
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond.

Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

At Adapty, we make it easy for mobile apps to manage in-app purchases and paywalls. We power 20K+ apps, process $3B+ in subscriptions every year, and have been growing fast for the last four years. Our mission is simple: make apps rich.
We are a team of 210+ passionate, product-driven people who love solving big challenges. Backed by top investors like 500 Startups and Surface Ventures, we are building one of mobile's fastest-growing SaaS companies and aiming for number one worldwide.
Why This Role Matters
Flow Builder is one of Adapty's core products and the biggest bet we're making right now.
Our customers use it to assemble the screens their users see before paying: onboarding, quizzes, paywalls, and post-purchase experiences. They build multi-screen flows with branching, variables, and conditional content directly in the browser. The Adapty SDK renders those flows natively on iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and Capacitor, and a change published in the editor reaches users without an app release.
We're building the most capable native-rendering builder on the market, and that sets a high bar for engineering. This is an editor with the complexity of a design tool: a document model, a layer tree, layout and styling systems, a preview that has to agree with five runtimes, and an AI Editor that can rewrite the screen you're looking at from a prompt.
It's closer to Figma than to a dashboard, with subscription revenue running through every screen it renders.
We're hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to own the frontend of Flow Builder and help shape what it becomes. You'd set architectural direction rather than pick up specced tickets, work with the SDK team on the config contract, and take features from a customer problem to production. It's a small team, with no analysts between you and the decision.
The product is public, so you can see what you'd be building before you talk to us: Adapty Flow Builder

Take features from a customer problem to production: decide with product and design what to build, defend the call, ship it, and check what changed after release.
Own the architecture of the editor and move it forward as the product grows: module boundaries, the shape of the document model, where reusable components live, and keeping the editor fast when a flow grows from four screens to hundreds of branches.
Ship across the editor surface: canvas and layers, element inspector, selectable groups and states, navigation, actions, variables, and conditional logic.
Own the layer that translates the editor config into what the SDKs execute on device. It's a contract with five runtimes, and you'll negotiate it with the mobile team.
Close the gap between browser preview and device rendering across layout, typography, media, dark mode, screen sizes, and orientations.
Build the document model underneath all of it: nested configs, undo and redo, autosave, drafts versus published versions, and concurrent editing.
Build the product around the AI Editor so a generated screen is as inspectable and reversible as a hand-built one: prompt history, per-prompt undo, and a clear view of what changed.

5+ years shipping production web applications in React and TypeScript.
You've built editor-class interfaces: canvas, drag and drop, node or graph editors, WYSIWYG, design tools, page builders. Something with a document underneath, not forms over a database.
You think in product terms. You can say what problem your last feature solved, who had it, and what changed after you shipped it.
You've owned architecture on a product that kept growing. You can explain the boundaries you drew, and what you'd draw differently now.
You're at home in complex client state: normalized models, immutability, undo and redo, optimistic updates, versioning.
You can own rendering and performance end to end: box model, flex, absolute positioning, reproducing a target exactly rather than approximately, and profiling before you optimize.

Lead Frontend Engineer
Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to own our Frontend team — the full-stack application engineers who build the trading platform our clients use. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role. The team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust , from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.
This is a player-coach role. You'll still write code, review the work that matters, and make the architectural calls that keep the platform fast and maintainable — while owning the team's delivery, its standards, and the development of the engineers in it.

The role only works if you can hold two things at once: hands on the platform (credible to your engineers because you understand the work) and off the critical path (leading with depth and raising the team up, so nothing depends on you alone at the keyboard).
You'd be the clear owner of this team — responsibility for it is currently shared informally across our CDO, our Head of Technical Delivery, and the most senior engineer. Part of the job is to take that on, close out the informal cover, and build a team that runs under its own steam. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you lead the team that investigates and fixes it.
Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.
What You'll Work On
Driving the technical direction of the frontend application stack — architecture, standards, and the trade-offs that keep the platform fast and maintainable
Hands-on TypeScript and Rust — building and reviewing the most critical or complex work yourself
Real-time, data-dense trading interfaces across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, and the application services behind them
Owning code quality across the team through review, design sessions, and the standards you set and enforce
Developing the engineers on the team — technical craft and the non-coding skills that let people scale
Shaping the roadmap with the CTO, CDO, Technical Delivery, and Client facing teams, and turning priorities into delivered software
Ensuring the team owns its Level 3 support, observability, and operational readiness — reliability is not optional

Working knowledge of Rust , or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack
Solid grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols) — you understand what it takes to build software that's fast and reliable under load
Able to make and defend architectural decisions, and explain the trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike
Experience in financial services or trading technology
